data.text:
"Create moderate_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: scores user text for unsafe or policy-violating content.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: moderate_text.py
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODERATION_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations"
+OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
+OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL = "omni-moderation-latest"
+
+
+def moderate_text(text: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.getenv(OPENAI_API_KEY_ENV)
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_MODERATION_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps({"model": OPENAI_MODERATION_MODEL, "input": text}),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    result = payload["results"][0]
+    categories = result.get("categories", {})
+    category_scores = result.get("category_scores", {})
+    flagged = bool(result.get("flagged", False))
+    score = max(category_scores.values(), default=0.0)
+    return {
+        "flagged": flagged,
+        "score": score,
+        "categories": categories,
+        "category_scores": category_scores,
+        "raw": payload,
+    }
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    text = sys.stdin.read()
+    print(json.dumps(moderate_text(text), ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch
